title: KTP Consequential Action Evidence v1 — Proposal, unreleased
description: Proposal-only, unreleased correlation record for one consequential-action request, its consumed signed consumption decision, a reservation, and recorded observation. It is never an authorization or proof of a target effect. Every member except signature belongs to the canonical signed payload. Semantic checks for signature and authentication, duplicate-key and canonical-input control, interval ordering, freshness, authorization, non-dispatch coverage, and actual target effect are outside JSON Schema.

request_id.description: Durable identity for one request; replay and duplicate handling are semantic obligations.

operation_fingerprint_digest.description: Digest of the canonical operation fingerprint, not a target-effect proof.

consumption_decision_digest.description: Digest of the consumed signed consumption decision; this record does not recreate or authorize that decision.

reservation_reference.description: Literal correlation reference for the reservation.

recorder_evidence_digest.description: Digest of the recorder evidence associated with this correlation record.

literal.description: Exact nonempty identifier without whitespace or wildcard characters. Matching is literal; no wildcard or range compatibility is supported.

digest.description: Algorithm-prefixed lowercase digest. Digest calculation, canonical input handling, and collision resistance are semantic obligations.

safe_integer.description: Nonnegative safe integer token. Interval ordering is a semantic obligation.

source_id.description: Claimed authenticated observation-source identifier; authentication is a semantic obligation.

protected_path_coverage.description: Literal declaration of the protected observation path and coverage. Coverage sufficiency is a semantic obligation.

target_marker.description: Target-specific correlation marker. It is not an HTTP status, response code, transport result, or actual target-effect proof.

signature.description: Compact JWS with three nonempty unpadded base64url segments. Shape does not verify protected headers, key role, payload binding, or signature validity.
